site_name: Part Ground Floor Former Debenhams Store, 275-287 Station Road
description: Erection of plant cage/compound and installation of air conditioning plant thereto, erection of plant to designated area on roof, and 2 no. openings in external wall for pipework/vent grill
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">Acoustic
Consultancy Report by Gsm Ltd ( dated – 04 August 2025), &nbsp;ICE 682-HARROW-PLN02, ICE 682-HARROW-PLN03, ICE
682-HARROW-AS01, ICE 682-HARROW-AS02, B2965 20F2, B2965 10F2, ICE 682-HARROW-SP03,
Flooring Details and Design and Access statement.&nbsp;</span>

<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed development shall be implemented in
accordance with the approved Acoustic Consultancy Report by Gsm Ltd ( dated –
04 August 2025), &nbsp;and shall be maintained
as such thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><br></p>

<p>The cumulative rating noise level from all plant and machinery shall not exceed&nbsp;<strong>10dB(A) below the prevailing background noise level&nbsp;</strong>(measured in accordance with BS4142:2014) at the nearest noise-sensitive premises. The plant shall operate 24/7 in compliance with&nbsp;<strong>Harrow Council’s plant noise limits</strong>, and the developer shall ensure that these noise limits are achieved and maintained thereafter through appropriate monitoring and mitigation measures.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the surfaces<span data-teams="true">&nbsp;to match as per the materials compound sheet (RF Pocket Guide).</span>
